notes.subject: timmeggtin
notes.rationale: עין 'titti' i d-yettwaseqdec d 'timeɣri/timmeggtin' — deg taɛbranit 'titti', talɣa tamhazart

notes.subject: בדלח
notes.rationale: abedlaḥ — awal ayen yellan kan sin n tikkal deg Tanakh (da d Tazwara 2:12), mačči d awal n teqbaylit

notes.subject: גד
notes.rationale: zzerɛ n (גד): kra n yimsuqelen qqaṛen 'coriander', wayed 'bdellium-plant' iḥercen — zzerɛ n useklu n bedlaḥ

notes.subject: l-man
notes.rationale: maḍen i d-yettwaxelsen seg 'man hu?' (Acu-t?) — yettwaseqdec yisem seg tuqqna n Yisrael, acu yella wezru-nni

translation: Maḍen, l-man d amdan am zzerɛ n (גד) i d-ibanen, timmeggtin-is d timmeggtin n ubedlaḥ.
